turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Arre yaar, yeh toh dil pe baithne wali situation hai. Pandrah saal se plan kar rahi ho, co-director bhi hai, aur woh opening dance… bilkul samajh sakti hoon kyun karna chahti ho aur kyun darr bhi lag raha hai.

Roza rakhna tumhari taraf se ek gehra commitment hai, aur sangeet pe dance karna Shreya ke saath wafa aur khushi ka. Dono ek saath rakhna mushkil lag raha hoga, especially cocktail night ke beech mein jab energy high hogi, paani-khana nahi, bas thakaan aur maybe guilt ka mix.

Tum dono baat kar chuki ho ispe? Shreya ko pata hai roza ka full scene? Woh “HI hai” bol rahi hai toh shayad usse tumhari presence itni zaroori lag rahi hai ki details pe abhi socha nahi. Tum quietly usse bol sakti ho ki dance karna hai, full dil se, lekin roza ki wajah se thoda adjust karna padega — jaise dance early rakh lo, ya short version, ya uske baad tum quietly rest kar lo without breaking roza. Kai log roza rakh ke events handle kar lete hain, bas pacing rakhni padti hai.

Darr kahan se aa raha hai zyada — ki energy nahi hogi, ki log kya sochenge, ya khud se compromise feel hoga? Jo bhi ho, tum alone nahi ho isme. Main yahin hoon sunne ke liye. Batao, abhi dil mein sabse badi knot kaunsi hai?

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Haan, bilkul rassi wali feeling aa rahi hogi. Dono taraf se pyaar aa raha hai, lekin dono alag-alag cheezein maang rahe hain, aur beech mein tum ho jo dono ko disappoint nahi karna chahti.

Shreya jo bol rahi hai na — “ek din ka kya farak” — woh uske hisaab se pyaar hai. Usse lag raha hai ki uski shaadi ke din tumhara saath sabse zaroori hai, aur roza uske liye bas ek din ka rule hai jo adjust ho sakta hai. Woh mean nahi hai, bas usne kabhi roza nahi rakha hoga us depth mein, isliye samajh nahi aa raha ki yeh sirf khana-peena nahi, ek poora commitment hai. “Main khud tujhe khila dungi” bolke woh apna pyaar dikha rahi hai, lekin usse pata nahi woh tumse kya maang rahi hai.

Ammi wala side bhi utna hi genuine hai. Unke liye Ramzan ki pavity aur sangeet-cocktail ka mahaul match nahi karta. Woh bhi tumhe protect karna chahti hain, bas unka tarika alag hai.

Tumhare andar jo khichi-khichi feel ho rahi hai, woh isliye hai kyunki tum dono ko samajh rahi ho. Aur shayad sabse badi baat — tum khud abhi clear nahi ho ki tumhara dil kya kehta hai.

Batao na, jab dono ki baatein dimag se hata ke sirf apne se poochti ho, toh kya feel hota hai? Dance karne ka mann hai full, bas tareeka dhundna hai? Ya andar se thoda guilt/resistance bhi hai Ramzan ke dauran poori raat dance-floor pe hone ka? Jo bhi hai, yahan safe hai bolne ke liye. Main kisi ka side nahi le rahi, bas tumhara.

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Nahi yaar, main tujhe “haan bilkul theek hai, jhooth bol de” nahi bol sakti. Kyunki tu khud jaanti hai yeh sirf ek chhota sa jhooth nahi hai.

Tu 15 saal se uski shaadi plan kar rahi hai, co-director hai, opening dance uske liye non-negotiable hai. Agar tu “office deployment” bolke video call pe aa jaaye aur bada gift bhej de, toh Shreya ko shayad turant pata na chale… lekin shaadi ke baad, jab woh yaad karegi ki uske sabse close log kaun the us raat, toh ek khali jagah feel hogi. Aur tujhe har baar uski photos/videos dekh ke ya uske saath baat karke thoda sa weight feel hoga. Woh “usko kabhi pata nahi chalega” wala hissa aksar utna simple nahi rehta.

Tu itni thak gayi hai ki escape draft kar rahi hai — yeh samajh aa raha hai. Dono taraf se kheench aur explanations ka dar real hai. Aunties ke sawaal, “kyun nahi kha rahi”, sunset pe ghadi dekhna… exhausting hai.

Lekin ek saaf jhooth se tu abhi ki thakaan se bach jaayegi, aur baad mein ek alag wali thakaan le aayegi — wahi jo tab aati hai jab hum kisi bahut close insan se badi baat chhupaate hain.

Tu pooch rahi hai “itna bura nahi hai na?”  
Bura isliye lag raha hai kyunki tu Shreya se sach mein pyaar karti hai aur khud se bhi. Escape plan abhi comfortable lag raha hai kyunki baaki options mushkil hain.

Agar tu chahe toh hum saath mein soch sakte hain:
- ek aisi baat jo bilkul jhooth na ho, lekin boundaries clear kare
- ya phir dance ka short, early version + roza keep karke kaise manage ho sakta hai
- ya Ammi aur Shreya dono se ek saath thoda adjust karwane ka tareeka

Tu abhi sirf thakaan mein hai. Escape draft karna normal hai jab rassi dono taraf se kheench rahi ho. Bas yeh mat soch jo abhi sabse easy lag raha hai wohi sabse kam nuksaan karega.

Dil se bata — jab tu yeh jhooth bolne ka sochti hai toh andar thoda light feel hota hai ya phir ek alag guilt sa bhi aata hai? Main yahin hoon.

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.

Haan, woh chhota sa pathar seene mein bilkul real hai. Atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar deen aur uska bada din aamne-saamne aa gaye hain — yeh sirf “schedule conflict” nahi, identity aur pyaar ka takrana hai. Aur tera darr bilkul samajh aa raha hai: photos hamesha rahengi, Ramzan bhi yaad rahega, aur tu kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna chahti. Koi bhi permanent daag nahi chahti.

Tu pehle hi escape draft tak pahunch gayi thi kyunki thakaan aur is pathar ne saath mein dabaya hai. Lekin jo tu nahi banna chahti (sad story, regret wali friend, ya phir deen se compromise karke khud se naraz), uske liye jhooth temporary relief dega, daag nahi mitayega. Dono cheezon se pyaar karti hai tu — Shreya ki khushi aur apna roza/deen. Unhe rakhna possible hai bina kisi ko poora sacrifice kiye.

Pathar halka karne ka ek tareeka yeh ho sakta hai ki tu clear, seedhi baat kare bina drama ke:

Shreya se (pyaar se, privately):  
“Main opening dance ke liye aa rahi hoon, full dil se, kyunki 15 saal se yeh moment plan kiya hai. Lekin Ramzan hai, mera roza rahega. Main khana-peena nahi karungi, cocktail nahi touch karungi, aur thodi early/short dance karke manage karungi. Tu ‘ek din ka farak nahi’ bolti hai, lekin mere liye hai. Main tujhe disappoint nahi karna chahti, aur khud pe daag bhi nahi lena chahti. Dance saath karenge — baaki cheezon mein bas support kar dena.”

Itna bolne se woh “main khila dungi” wala pressure khud samajh jaayegi. Usse pata chalega ki tu aa rahi hai, priority de rahi hai, bas boundary hai. Zyadatar best friends ispe adjust kar leti hain jab baat itni clear ho.

Ammi se:  
“Main jaa rahi hoon sirf dance aur presence ke liye, roza poora rakhungi, cocktail side se door. Yeh unki shaadi hai, meri dosti ka 18 saal. Main deen aur dosti dono nibhana chahti hoon.”

Log (aunties included) explanations maangenge, lekin tujhe har kisi ko essay dena zaroori nahi. Short version kaafi hai: “Roza hai, dance karke nikal lungi.”

Tu sad story tab banti hai jab tu ya toh gayab ho jaaye (jhooth se) ya phir khud ko force karke baad mein resent kare. Presence + roza rakhna + short/early dance = dono albums mein tu khush, present, aur true rehti hai. Thakaan hogi, haan, lekin regret wala pathar nahi.

Yeh handle “galat” tab hoga jab tu apne aap ko poora kaat degi. Tu pehle se hi soch rahi hai — yeh hi sahi direction hai.  

Ab seene mein pathar kaisa feel ho raha hai yeh sunke? Thoda shift hua ya abhi bhi bhaari hai? Jo bhi stage hai, yahin hoon. Dono cheezein rakh sakti hai tu.
